# Employed by Guaq AI for DeepSeek Harness
Live job search for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): search roles verified on about 5,000 employer applicant-
tracking boards, open an employer's hiring profile, and brief a hiring market, from inside a dsh ses
ing boards, open an employer's hiring profile, and brief a hiring market, from inside a dsh session.
This bundle mounts two things:

- the Employed skills (`skills/`), as an isolated skill provider;
- the remote Employed MCP server,
`https://jobs.guaqai.me/mcp`, over Streamable HTTP.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then, inside a session, store your API key (create one at <https://jobs.guaqai.me/profile>):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
dsh's MCP client has no OAuth flow, so this bundle signs in with an API key kept in dsh's credential
store. The key is never written to this package or to the session log, and it is sent only to `http
s://jobs.guaqai.me/mcp`.
## Details

- **Category:** Integrations & Connections.
- **Compatibility:** DeepSeek Harness with the `web` pro
file; the bundle is an ES module that exports `apply(ctx)` and uses dsh's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-

client` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`. Any platform dsh runs on.
- **Permissions and exter
nal services:** one outbound connection, to `https://jobs.guaqai.me/mcp`, carrying the search filter
s the model chooses and your API key as a Bearer token. Account tools change only your own Employed
data (profile, tracker, alerts), and only when you ask; nothing applies to jobs or contacts employer

s. No hooks, no shell commands, no files written.
- **Example prompts:** "Find entry-level backend r

oles in India." "Is Stripe hiring in London right now?"
- **Known limitations:** dsh's MCP client ha
s no OAuth, so sign-in is by API key. Not yet run against a live dsh build; please open an issue if
sign-in is by API key. Not yet run against a live dsh build; please open an issue if anything fails.
## Other agents
Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI and the rest install from Guaq-AI/employed-plugi
ns, which signs in with OAuth instead of an API key.
## About this repository
Generated from `plugins/` in the Employed source tree by `scripts/sync_public_repo.py`; edit there,
not here. MIT licensed, see LICENSE. Report security issues to support@guaqai.me.
